Yes, this feels right. Starting with a manageable batch and then loading another few in place — without jumping me to the top or resetting my search and tag controls — is a sensible way to handle a big collection. It keeps the list from being an overwhelming wall all at once, but I stay where I am while more fill in.

And your key assumption is the important one for me: search and the tag filters should look across my *whole* collection, not just the handful of cards currently on screen. It'd be pretty broken if searching only found things in the batch I happened to have loaded — I'd assume something was missing. As long as finding things always considers everything I've saved, this batching approach is fine. Good — this matches my intent. Let's keep going.
